premises.text: Without rapid accessible diagnostics, outbreaks spread while patients wait months; dipsticks lack sensitivity and PCR is costly and not portable
premises.evidence_span: Without rapid, accessible diagnostics to determine who is infected, diseases continue to spread

premises.text: FastChip is a vacuum-powered, zero-external-equipment isothermal amplification chip with smartphone optical readout in about an hour
premises.evidence_span: a field-ready, affordable, sensitive, and trackable solution

premises.text: An app tracks GPS, patient info, and results to form a disease-tracking network for ministries of health
premises.evidence_span: an app that tracks GPS data, patient info, and test results. So this becomes a powerful disease tracking network

premises.text: Launch first as a research toolkit, then as a human diagnostic kit after sample prep and FDA clearance
premises.evidence_span: Initially, we plan to launch this as a research toolkit. Then, after integrating sample prep and clearing FDA approval, we'll market this as a human diagnostic kit

value.text: Fight epidemics with rapid decentralized molecular diagnostics
value.evidence_span: fight epidemics with rapid molecular diagnostics
